subject: BLANK WHEN ZERO clause
notes: kb/Work PB508 landed. GR2 defines a category-numeric subject numeric-edited for BOTH usages SR2 admits, display and national. The promotion once tested usage display alone (PB508's finding); PB646 widened it when national-form numerics became real, and PB508's landing pins it: the promotion and SR2's own screen (DataBinder.BlankWhenZeroViolation) ask the one predicate UsageFamilies.IsDisplayOrNational, and BlankWhenZeroUsagePairDriftTests measures promotion against the predicate over every Usage member. Goldens: pb508_blank_when_zero_national (a PIC 9(5) USAGE NATIONAL BLANK WHEN ZERO item blanks on a stored zero exactly as its display twin does, shows 00012 after MOVE 12 and de-edits to a numeric receiver) and pb508_blank_when_zero_national_resultant (ADD 1 TO the item is COBOL1675, the arithmetic-resultant refusal that is only true if GR2 defined the item numeric-edited; refused 2002-2023). Both were mutation-checked: with the promotion reverted to usage display alone the first prints 00000 for the zero store and the second compiles. Below 2002 USAGE NATIONAL is itself refused (pb646-national-form-numeric-at-85, COBOL0900).
